paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: : F1 score results
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates F1 score results for MADLLM and its variants across different datasets. The horizontal axis represents the datasets, labeled “SMD”, “PSM”, “SWaT”, “SMAP”, and “MSL”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “F1 Score (%)”, is a linear scale ranging from 70 to 100, with tick marks placed at intervals of 10.  For each dataset, there are four bars representing different configurations: “MADLLM” in light green, “MADLLM w/o feature embedding” in pale purple, “MADLLM w/o skip embedding” in light orange, and a fourth unnamed bar in a muted green. Within each dataset, the bars are shown grouped side-by-side.  For the “SMD” dataset, the “MADLLM” bar reaches approximately 93, “MADLLM w/o feature embedding” is around 90, “MADLLM w/o skip embedding” is about 84, and the unnamed bar is approximately 81.  The “MSL” dataset shows the lowest bar heights, with the “MADLLM” bar at approximately 91,  “MADLLM w/o feature embedding” around 89, the unnamed bar at about 87, and “MADLLM w/o skip embedding” at roughly 85. No bars are emphasized with different shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
